title: Event Experiences Marketing Manager - FIFA Fan Festival
description: Description FIFA27 established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). Department: Commercial & Marketing Location: Brazil Description FIFA27 established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). THE POSITION The Event Experiences Marketing Manager (FFF) supports and implements all strategic deliverables prescribed by the Experiential Marketing Manager (FFF) based in Zurich. This includes developing, supporting, and delivering innovative and best-in-class FFF deliverables and other experiential marketing activations that might be developed. The core deliverable is to lead the strategic and commercial development and positioning of the FIFA Fan Festival™ across Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027, focusing on the commercial, promotional, brand, entertainment, and partner and stakeholder integrations. Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, the manager will help shape the narrative, drive partner and government integration, and develop innovative fan engagement in line with FIFA’s strategic objectives from a local perspective. This role and team will work in tandem with the Special Events team at FIFA27, who hold accountabilities for all operational elements of the FFF. However, on a day‑to‑day basis, the Strategy and Operations teams will operate and be perceived as one unified team. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES FIFA Fan Festival™ FWWC2027 - Commercial & Strategy Support the development and implementation of the FIFA Fan Festival™ commercial and strategic framework. Support communications and promotional planning across Host Cities. Liaise with commercial and media partners (alongside the local Commercial and Media partnership teams) to support project alignment and approvals. Prepare workshop planning, presentations, and strategic alignment sessions. Maintain all SharePoint documentation and ensure excellent level of project document management Lead on local conversations and meetings while delivering detailed meetings and project updates including meeting minutes and communications for reporting back to the team in Zurich. Support budget tracking, procurement processes, and relevant strategic documentation. Support local issue resolution and escalation processes, ensuring key decisions, risks and dependencies are clearly communicated to the Zurich team. Support the review of plans and materials to ensure alignment with FIFA commercial rights, partner obligations, and clean site principles. Provide local market insights and stakeholder contexts to support strategic decision making, planning, and delivery when needed. FIFA Fan Festival™ FWWC2027 - Host City Coordination Support Host Cities throughout all strategy and commercial processes. Act as a key point of contact for Host Cities at local level and any other local stakeholders. Coordinate requests, tracking, review and adaptation of Host City deliverables, including promotional copy, brand assets, content inputs and local information. Review and adapt Host City content, copy and materials to ensure consistency with FIFA tone, messaging, objectives and standards. Develop a strong understanding of the FWWC27 brand manual and ensure Host City and stakeholder materials are reviewed in line with FIFA brand requirements. Coordinate feedback, brand approvals, and final sign-off with relevant internal FIFA teams. Or communicate with FIFA Zurich where necessary. Support the local Special Events team to ensure FIFA Fan Festival™ strategic, commercial, promotional and brand requirements are understood and integrated into Host City planning and delivery. Support the coordination of content capture Delivery of local reporting inputs and post event documentation for FIFA27 and Host Cities and relevant stakeholders. Experiential Projects Act as project manager for selected experiential marketing projects as required. Coordinate project planning, timelines, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, and execution. Support RFP processes, agency evaluation, supplier onboarding, and procurement processes when required. Manage day-to-day coordination with agencies and suppliers, ensuring clear briefs, timelines, feedback rounds, and delivery expectations. Maintain all project documentation, trackers, meeting notes, action lists, and approval records. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and in line with FIFA standards and identify, track and communicate key project risks, dependencies, decisions and escalation points. Support post-project reporting, learnings and evaluation, including documentation of outcomes, performance and recommendations. YOUR PROFILE 4+ years’ experience in marketing, event management, or relevant client account management Proven relevant experience in similar position or another relevant role Experience working in a multi-national, multi-cultural, and multi-stakeholder environment Appreciation and understanding or sport and the role it plays in marketing, fan engagement and popular culture University degree in a marketing discipline, or business administration with major in a relevant field (desired) Proficient in Office 365 Excellent knowledge of MS Teams, SharePoint/One Drive, Monday.com Flexible, adaptable, proactive, attention to detail, and constantly striving for excellence Multi-tasker with excellent organizational skills and time/priority management Excellent oral and written communication skills Stress resilient and able to work to immovable deadlines Excellent stakeholder and network management skills, including understanding and awareness of cultural nuances and communication needs for different stakeholders Comprehensive understanding of entertainment, major events and fan entertainment understanding Diplomatic and comfortable handling conflicts in a positive and objective manner Team Player and Adaptability with strong teamwork abilities and willing to go the extra mile Requirements Fluent in English and Portuguese Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

THE POSITION The Venue Technology Manager is responsible for supporting the Technology team with venue specific technology related deliverables for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and / or associated events within Brazil. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Responsible to ensure all aspects of Technology, Telecommunications and Broadcast Technology Services are implemented in accordance with the pre‑agreed FIFA Technology requirements at the assigned venue(s) Manage a strong diverse Venue Technology team composed of paid staff, contractors and volunteers for operating the technology services at the assigned venue(s) Collaborate with stakeholders’ groups, clients, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring the delivery of technology services across all venues, in accordance with the defined governance structure Manage and contribute to the venue technology working groups in accordance with the agreed governance structure across all aspects of the tournament programme (planning, implementation, readiness and operations) Manage the technology demand / needs requirements for technology services across the tournament space (Technology Equipment Allocation Process) Plan the delivery of suitable end user technology equipment and services to all FWWC 2027 departments and FIFA constituent groups, including hardware, services and consumables Facilitate the collection and distribution of technology requirements of all client groups involved in the FWWC 2027 across all client groups, including, Media, Broadcast, Commercial, Football Technology etc. Ensure that all information pertaining to infrastructure, services and spaces needed for the delivery and support of all technology services are communicated to, and understood by, venue/site authorities and respective delivery teams Provide guidance and direction to relevant teams on matters relating to the structural build‑out and technology services implementation, including the commissioning and final decommissioning of tournament venues In collaboration with assigned personnel and Stadium partners, relevant parties (private and governmental) enable / support the timely delivery of venue technology services. Identify and report on the progress of all critical dependencies in accordance with the reporting methodologies Manage the asset tracking and management of deployed technology equipment Track the progress of structural build‑out and IT implementation leading up to the timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and final decommissioning of the venues Develop regular progress, risk and issue management reports in accordance with the governance structure / reporting methodologies and, or PMO systems Follow‑up with various stakeholders, providers, and government entities in relation to ensuring delivery of technology services / dependencies as per agreed requirements, service levels etc. Support and ensure the team adhere to the IT Service management protocols Ensure positive attitude from the Venue Technology teams and good relationship with all the parties, including FIFA teams, Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) areas/projects, end‑users, suppliers, Host Country/ City counterparts Manage the on‑site IT Technicians and support teams during tournament time operations, including end‑of‑day reporting and incident escalation to Technology Command Centre. YOUR PROFILE Education University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field Experience Minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role Experience in the Sports / major event industry is a must Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and projects Skills & Competencies Manager with proven track record in similar projects Good knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events Have up to date knowledge and project management expertise in all event related technologies, including, all types of technology business solutions, community access TV (CATV), radio communications, wired communication, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual. Ability to always maintain a professional demeanor. Consistently interacts professionally and works productively with all levels of employee. Excellent cross group collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to lead virtual teams across groups, conflict management and driving consensus to deliver on program milestones Good Leadership skills and able to manage and motivate other team members Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation Excellent verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills Ability to adapt speech to audience coming from a broad spectrum of disciplines and with various levels of technical knowledge Leadership and accountability across all areas of relevance Strong political acumen and adaptable to a wide range of working environments Certifications & Requirements Right to work in Brazil Fluent in English Native or Fluent in Portuguese Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset #J-18808-Ljbffr

Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. What we believe in #Clarity. We build products and experiences we’re proud of. #Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action. #Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission. If you’re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America. Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team. title: Staff Software Engineer - Digital Experience Platform
description: Staff Software Engineer - Digital Experience Platform Staff Software Engineer – Digital Experience Platform (DXP) About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and beyond — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. We combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. The Digital Experience Platform (DXP) is Nubank’s AI-first platform ecosystem designed to radically compress our product development workflow from concept to production. Today, building “Magic App”-quality experiences in our Backend-Driven Content (BDC) stack takes ~49 working days and ~24 handoff-heavy steps — DXP exists to close this Creation Gap and Workflow Gap by making AI-native tooling the default way we design, build, and ship experiences. We are building four core products: DXP Studio (an AI-powered creation environment that turns Figma designs into production-ready BDC code), DXP Dictionary (the curated knowledge base that makes AI agents “Nu-aware”), DXP Spec Protocol (our vendor-agnostic abstraction layer), and DXP Workflow (an orchestration platform for hybrid human + AI agent teams across the product lifecycle). As a Staff Software Engineer – DXP , you will be the technical leader and multiplier for this initiative: shaping the architecture of an AI-native platform, driving critical decisions across the Figma-to-BDC pipeline and agent orchestration, and partnering closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to prove value and scale the platform company-wide. We’re looking for someone genuinely addicted to AI — who obsessively explores new models, agent frameworks, and AI-powered tools, and can turn that passion into leverage for thousands of Nubank engineers. You’ll be responsible for Architect the DXP Studio pipeline: Design and lead the end-to-end architecture for the Figma → DXP Spec → BDC code generation flow, ensuring vendor-agnostic abstractions (DXP Spec Protocol), NuDS component fidelity, and production-ready output quality. Lead AI agent integration & orchestration: Define how AI agents (codegen, QA, design-mapping, etc.) are composed, executed, and supervised inside DXP; drive decisions on LLM provider abstraction, context-assembly strategies, MCP tool surfaces, and execution environments. Own the DXP Dictionary and knowledge architecture: Architect the knowledge base that turns generic AI into Nubank-aware agents — how NuDS specs, tokens, canonical patterns and domain knowledge are ingested, structured, and consumed by generation and validation pipelines. Drive cross-platform integration: Lead the technical integration model with NuDS (component catalog & tokens), BDC/Core (patterns & services), HPP (widget / homepage infrastructure), and App Excellence (observability & quality metrics), defining clear contracts that position DXP as an orchestrator on top of existing platforms. Establish quality-at-generation-time: Design automated quality enforcement for generated experiences — NuDS compliance, token correctness, accessibility rules, structural integrity, golden tests — so governance happens by default at generation time, not via manual post-hoc review. Set technical strategy and roadmap: Contribute to the 6–18 month technical strategy for DXP, translating strategic bets into executable plans, identifying architectural risks and trade-offs between POCs and long-term scalability. Multiply engineering excellence: Mentor engineers within DXP and partner teams (NuDS, BDC, Mobile Platform), lead design reviews and RFCs, and raise the bar for AI-augmented development practices across Nubank. We are looking for a person who has Must Have Genuine obsession with AI tools and workflows — deep, hands‑on, daily experience with LLMs, AI agents and modern AI‑powered dev tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, custom agents, MCP servers); you are the person who has tried new tools before others even ask about them. Strong software architecture skills , with experience designing multi‑component platform systems that integrate AI/LLM capabilities into production workflows. Deep understanding of design‑to‑code pipelines, design systems or component‑driven UI development , ideally bridging design tooling (e.g., Figma) and code generation. Practical experience with AI/LLM integration in software products : prompt engineering, agent orchestration, context management, RAG architectures and/or MCP tool development. Proven ability to lead cross‑functional technical initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders, driving alignment and delivery in ambiguous environments. Excellent communication skills , translating complex architectural decisions into clear narratives for Product, Design and senior leadership. Product‑minded mindset , balancing technical excellence with pragmatic delivery — comfortable proving value via POCs before scaling platform capabilities. Experience with Nubank’s stack or similar patterns : BDC (Backend‑Driven Content), and broader mobile/frontend ecosystems. Will be a Plus Experience with Flutter at the intersection of design systems and code generation. Hands‑on experience building or integrating AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Devin, Cursor) into team workflows. Familiarity with workflow orchestration platforms , agent farms or multi‑agent systems. Understanding of analytical architectures , experimentation platforms, feature flags and progressive rollout strategies for generated experiences. Prior experience productizing internal developer tools or platforms that serve large engineering orgs. Contributions to open‑source AI developer tools or active presence in the AI‑for‑developers community. Location for this opportunity This role can be based in one of the following hubs: For global, multi‑location roles like this, our benefits package is competitive in each country and generally includes: Competitive compensation and the opportunity of earning equity at Nu Health / Medical Insurance Life Insurance (and AD&D where applicable) Extended maternity and paternity leaves Nucleo – our learning platform of courses NuCare – our mental health and wellness assistance program Paid time off and local holidays Retirement / savings plans (e.g., 401(k), HSA/FSA in the US; country‑specific plans elsewhere) Work‑from‑home allowance Relocation assistance package, if applicable Details for each location will be shared during the process, aligned with local regulations and practices. If you want to define how an AI‑native bank designs and ships product experiences — turning agentic workflows, design systems and code generation into everyday tools for hundreds of teams — we’d love to hear from you. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Manager, Service Delivery Planning
description: This role is responsible for managing the Service Delivery Planning team, which provides pre-sales support to the Sales and Solutions Engineering across all Verticals, for complex Managed and Professional Services. The Service Delivery Planning interfaces with commercial teams throughout the world to establish Service Implementation Plans in the pre-sales phase, and successfully transition opportunities into implementation. The value provided to the business includes the optimization of individual customer opportunities, with winning technical solutions, credible schedules and budgets, and alignment of internal and external resources, leveraging a cost-effective and scalable service portfolio. The Manager of the Service Delivery Planning team provides guidance to the team, reviews and approves Implementation Plans for high value and critical deals, and builds alignment with regional commercial leaders. The role requires a strong control of the project pipeline and good forecasting capabilities to support the department’s ability to plan for resources, hardware inventory, and agreements with Service Delivery Partners. The Manager of the Service Delivery Planning team is accountable for optimizing controllable Cost of Sales for opportunities in the pre-sales phase, by ensuring that existing inventory is leveraged where practical and by enforcing adherence to the partnership strategy established with key Service Delivery Partners. This role requires intense cross-team collaboration with leaders across the business, Engineering and Operations teams, as well as with external stakeholders. The Manager develops the team, hires the right talent, and creates a culture of forward movement and accountability. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS Build and develop a strong team with multi-disciplinary and diverse talent, spread throughout the world for best-in-class pre-sales support to Solutions Engineers and Sales. Organize Service Implementation Planning activities for all Managed and Professional Services, with focus put on most complex solutions that require extensive orchestration across Engineering, Operations, and Service Delivery. Develop relationships with internal customers in the Vertical Markets and Product Management. Support strategic customer meetings and presentations. Work with the Field Services organization to develop an ecosystem that matches the needs of SES’ Service Portfolio. Leverage your excellent understanding of the customer base and market demand to craft optimal plans for complex and strategic deals, optimizing time to revenue and profitability. Provide actionable reports to partners across the Service Delivery organization and leaders in Vertical Markets to align forecasting and readiness levels, thus effectively supporting critical in-year revenue. Maintain up to date knowledge on SES products and industry technology. COMPETENCIES Excellent written and verbal communications. Ability to commune internally and externally with confidence on all field related matters. Demonstrable problem-solving skills, using industry standard methods and best practices. Self-starting, solutions orientated with an elevated level of personal accountability. Ability to challenge and be challenged, while maintaining balance, and thoughtful consideration of other parties always. Ability to work in an everchanging environment while still maintaining a high degree of accuracy in all things. A team player that can manage and work into a cross functional team that are geographically separated. Aware of social and cultural differences and the need to respect all. A challenger of poor behaviour and a champion of diversity. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE A four-year college degree in Engineering or business. At least 10 years of relevant experience in Product Management, Program Management or Sales Engineering in the Telecommunications industry. Good knowledge of the economics and operations of telecommunications networks. Strong interpersonal skills and cultural awareness. Effective written and verbal communication skills and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audience in English. Proficiency in a second language, preferably Spanish, French, or Portuguese. Proven ability to work in a cross-functional team environment and retain a positive attitude while simultaneously handling multiple complex projects with demanding schedules. Experience working in matrixed organization and demonstrated ability to influence key stakeholders. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills. Excellent organizational skills. SES and its Affiliated Companies are committed to providing fair and equal employment opportunities to all. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, protected veteran status, disability, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Data Analyst
description: About ONErpm ONErpm strives to ensure its legacy as a global brand with an impact on the artistic community, the music business, and society as a whole — we are an inclusive company focused on innovation, music, and technology. Therefore, we value mutual respect and understand that different perspectives drive innovation, accelerate growth, and lead to more sustainable decisions and outcomes. If you join us, regardless of where or in which position, we will support you in delivering your best and reaching your full potential. Our pioneering company, in less than 16 years, has managed to capture more than 20% of the digital music market in Brazil and currently operates in Mexico, the United States, Colombia, Argentina, Peru, Chile, Jamaica, Spain, Nigeria, Vietnam, and more. As of May 2026, ONErpm has more than 45 offices in 35 countries across nearly every continent around the world. Responsibilities Develop advanced dashboards and reports in Microsoft Power BI to generate actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making. Analyze and interpret complex data using Google Analytics and other web analytics platforms to identify trends and opportunities. Optimize data workflows and enhance analytical processes to improve efficiency and data accuracy. Communicate findings effectively through clear, concise reports and presentations for internal stakeholders. Lead Business Intelligence initiatives that contribute to strategic planning and overall business . Requirements Strong experience with data analysis tools and methodologies, with the ability to transform data into meaningful business insights. Create and maintain dashboards and reports that provide relevant insights for business areas. Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, creating impactful analyses, dashboards, and reports. Experience with SQL and DBT to support data analysis and workflow optimization. Knowledge of Python and cloud architecture will be considered a plus. Strong analytical mindset with a high level of attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities. Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and effectively. Professional fluency in English. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or related fields is preferred. title: Staff Software Engineer - Digital Experience Platform
description: Staff Software Engineer – Digital Experience Platform (DXP) About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and beyond — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. We combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more at: About the Role The Digital Experience Platform (DXP) is Nubank’s AI-first platform ecosystem designed to radically compress our product development workflow from concept to production. Today, building “Magic App”-quality experiences in our Backend-Driven Content (BDC) stack takes ~49 working days and ~24 handoff-heavy steps — DXP exists to close this Creation Gap and Workflow Gap by making AI-native tooling the default way we design, build, and ship experiences. We are building four core products: DXP Studio (an AI-powered creation environment that turns Figma designs into production-ready BDC code), DXP Dictionary (the curated knowledge base that makes AI agents “Nu-aware”), DXP Spec Protocol (our vendor-agnostic abstraction layer), and DXP Workflow (an orchestration platform for hybrid human + AI agent teams across the product lifecycle). As a Staff Software Engineer – DXP , you will be the technical leader and multiplier for this initiative: shaping the architecture of an AI-native platform, driving critical decisions across the Figma-to-BDC pipeline and agent orchestration, and partnering closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to prove value and scale the platform company-wide. We’re looking for someone genuinely addicted to AI — who obsessively explores new models, agent frameworks, and AI-powered tools, and can turn that passion into leverage for thousands of Nubank engineers. You’ll be responsible for Architect the DXP Studio pipeline: Design and lead the end-to-end architecture for the Figma → DXP Spec → BDC code generation flow, ensuring vendor-agnostic abstractions (DXP Spec Protocol), NuDS component fidelity, and production-ready output quality. Lead AI agent integration & orchestration: Define how AI agents (codegen, QA, design-mapping, etc.) are composed, executed, and supervised inside DXP; drive decisions on LLM provider abstraction, context-assembly strategies, MCP tool surfaces, and execution environments. title: Regional Operational Excellence Leader
description: Overview Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity. Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science. Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture. Hello. We’re Haleon. A new world-leading consumer health company. Shaped by all who join us. Together, we’re improving everyday health for billions of people by growing and innovating our portfolio of trusted, category-leading brands through a unique combination of deep human understanding and trusted science. Role Summary Como Diretor Regional de Excelência Operacional, você liderará a implementação global do Sistema de Produção Haleon (HPS) em diferentes regiões e países, garantindo forte alinhamento estratégico com os objetivos regionais e promovendo melhoria de desempenho sustentável em grande escala. Esta é uma função de liderança sênior, com responsabilidade por estratégia, desenvolvimento de capacidades, engajamento e execução, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com líderes regionais, equipes de liderança das plantas e comunidades de excelência operacional em toda a Haleon. Você atuará como um líder global de transformação e coach, incorporando as formas de trabalho do HPS enquanto desenvolve a capacidade organizacional e a maturidade operacional em nossa rede de manufatura. Um Dia na Vida (O que você fará) Fornecer liderança estratégica e direcionamento para o programa Sistema de Produção Haleon e sua implementação em vários países. Estabelecer parceria com equipes de liderança regionais e das plantas para garantir forte engajamento, planejamento de mudança organizacional, desenvolvimento de capacidades e implementação estruturada em todas as unidades. Governar o planejamento de implementação, acompanhamento do progresso, avaliação de lacunas e revisões de desempenho, removendo barreiras e acelerando a maturidade do HPS. Servir como modelo, coach e treinador para líderes e equipes nos padrões e comportamentos do Sistema de Produção Haleon. Liderar comunicações do HPS, benchmarking, compartilhamento de melhores práticas, lições aprendidas e disseminação de conhecimento entre as regiões. Apoiar o planejamento de recursos, desenvolvimento de capacidades e recrutamento para funções do Sistema de Produção Haleon nas plantas. Fornecer opções estruturadas para resolver desafios operacionais complexos, priorizar soluções, gerar alinhamento e impulsionar uma execução disciplinada. Áreas de Conhecimento e Experiência que buscamos Mais de 10 anos de experiência em liderança em Excelência Operacional, Manufatura ou Gestão da Cadeia de Suprimentos Forte experiência na aplicação de princípios de Lean Manufacturing e Melhoria Contínua Comprovada capacidade de liderança de projetos, programas e pessoas Qualificações Preferenciais Capacidade de engajar, influenciar e inspirar stakeholders em todos os níveis organizacionais Conforto para atuar em um ambiente global complexo e matricial Experiência comprovada na liderança de iniciativas de mudança em larga escala Forte visão de negócios, tanto comercial quanto operacional Experiência em ambiente farmacêutico sob cGMP ou manufatura regulada Forte capacidade analítica, com habilidade para equilibrar pensamento estratégico e execução prática Alto nível de responsabilidade, flexibilidade e senso de urgência Roles and Experience (Continuação) As Regional Operational Excellence Director, you will lead the global deployment of the Haleon Production System (HPS) across regions and countries, ensuring strong strategic alignment with regional objectives and delivering sustainable performance improvement at scale. This is a senior leadership role with accountability for strategy, capability building, engagement, and execution, working closely with regional leaders, site leadership teams, and operational excellence communities across Haleon. You will act as a global change leader and coach, embedding HPS ways of working while developing organizational capability and operational maturity across our manufacturing network. Day in the Life (What you’ll do) Provide strategic leadership and direction for the Haleon Production System programme and its deployment across multiple countries. Partner with regional and site leadership teams to ensure strong engagement, people change planning, capability building, and structured deployment at all sites. Govern deployment planning, progress tracking, gap assessments, and performance reviews, removing barriers and accelerating HPS maturity. Role model, coach, and train leaders and teams on Haleon Production System standards and behaviours. Lead HPS communications, benchmarking, best-practice sharing, lessons learned, and knowledge propagation across regions. Support resourcing, capability planning, and recruitment for site-level Haleon Production System roles. Provide structured options to resolve complex operational challenges, prioritise solutions, build alignment, and drive disciplined execution. Your Areas of Knowledge and Expertise we need 10+ years of leadership experience in Operational Excellence, Manufacturing, or Supply Chain Management Strong experience applying Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement principles Proven project, programme, and people leadership capability Preferred Qualifications Ability to engage, influence, and inspire stakeholders at all organisational levels Comfortable operating within a complex, global matrix environment Demonstrated experience leading large-scale change initiatives Strong commercial and operational business acumen Experience within a cGMP pharmaceutical or regulated manufacturing environment Strong analytical capability with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on execution High levels of accountability, flexibility, and sense of urgency Why Haleon At Haleon, the Win as One Framework guides how we lead and deliver impact. Leaders are expected to put consumers first, collaborate across boundaries, unlock value at pace, and grow themselves and others. As a leader, you are a role model for ethical leadership, embedding the Code of Conduct, fostering trust and inclusion, encouraging Speak Up, and addressing compliance matters with integrity and professionalism. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Haleon we embrace our diverse workforce by creating an inclusive environment that celebrates our unique perspectives, generates curiosity to create unmatched understanding of each other, and promotes fair and equitable outcomes for everyone. We’re striving to create a climate where we celebrate our diversity in all forms by treating each other with respect, listening to different viewpoints, supporting our communities, and creating a workplace where your authentic self belongs and thrives. We believe in an agile working culture for all our roles. If flexibility is important to you, we encourage you to explore with our hiring team what the opportunities are. Job Posting End Date: Equal Opportunities Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence. title: Post Doctoral Research Associate -2
description: Overview The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff for fit makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth. Join Howard University and thrive with us! Job Purpose Howard University’s University Transportation Center seeks a highly qualified Postdoctoral Research Associate specializing in structural health monitoring (SHM) of transportation infrastructure. The associate will lead and support federally funded projects aimed at developing and deploying advanced sensing, data analysis, and system identification techniques to assess the condition of transportation assets. Nature And Scope Support transportation engineering research at Howard University. The role engages with internal faculty and researchers, as well as external partners. Principal Accountabilities Support the Center’s mission by managing and executing research activities on transportation infrastructure safety, research implementation, and technology transfer initiatives. Collaborate with internal faculty, researchers, and external partners to plan and carry out research to design, implement, and validate structural health monitoring (SHM) methods. Conduct field deployments; process large-scale time-series data; apply statistical, machine-learning, computer vision, and signal-processing methods to detect damage or degradation. Contribute to proposal writing, technical reports, presentations, and peer-reviewed publications. Facilitate workshops, seminars, and public engagement events related to transportation engineering. Assist in meeting all reporting requirements for sponsored research projects. Core Competencies Ph.D. in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a closely related field. Demonstrated expertise in structural health monitoring, system identification, and signal processing. Proficiency with system identification methods, structural dynamics, and programming environments (e.g., MATLAB, Python). Experience with statistical and machine-learning techniques applied to time-series or spatial data. Strong organizational skills: ability to manage multiple tasks, adhere to deadlines, and collaborate across disciplines. Excellent written and oral communication skills, evidenced by peer-reviewed publications or conference presentations. Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse research team. Minimum Requirements Ph.D. in a scientific and/or research discipline related to the research projects. Compliance Salary Range Disclosure $60,000-$70,000 #J-18808-Ljbffr

Foco em Resultados: Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e trabalhar focado no atingimento das metas de vendas individuais e da equipe. Gestão de carteira: Experiência prática na utilização de sistemas CRM (como RD Station e similares). Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização de dados e relatórios de vendas (como dashboards ou plataformas de BI). Inglês Intermediário (para dar aquele match especial com a cultura do Ibeu!). Especialização: Pós-graduação lato sensu concluída ou em andamento em áreas voltadas a Negócios, Gestão Comercial ou Marketing. O que oferecemos de especial para o nosso time de receita: Remuneração Variável Atrativa: Aqui, o seu bolso é o limite! Além do salário fixo, oferecemos um modelo de comissionamento atrelado ao atingimento de metas e fechamento de contratos corporativos. Se você foca em receita, nós recompensamos a sua alta performance. Informações adicionais: O Ibeu é feito de pessoas e prezamos pela diversidade e inclusão, sendo assim, nossas vagas são destinadas a todos. Ao se candidatar para as vagas abertas no Ibeu, seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para a seleção dos candidatos. Caso não seja admitido neste momento, os dados coletados poderão ser mantidos em nossos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos.
